source_refs.note: Roman Urdu: practice long questions written from Chapter 17 (PDF 4-16), not printed in the book; same questions and order as the English set. Drafts needing academic review.

blocks.text: Yeh chapter 17 (Group 2 Elements) ke poore chapter se practice long questions (tafseeli sawal) hain, Board ke long question ki shakal mein: har sawal 4 number ka hai (wazahat, equations, zaroorat ho to diagram), aur chapter ke numericals qadam ba qadam hal kiye gaye hain. Har sawal ka poora model jawab hai.

blocks.prompt:
1 Describe the general characteristics of Group 2 elements: their position, name, occurrence, electronic configuration and some important uses mentioned in the chapter. (4 marks)
(Group 2 elements ki aam khasusiyaat bayan karein: periodic table mein jagah, naam, maujoodgi, electronic configuration aur chapter mein diye gaye kuch aham istemal.)
blocks.explanation:
Jagah: Group 2 elements (Be, Mg, Ca, Sr, Ba) periodic table ke Group 2 ke s block elements hain.

Naam: inhein un ki metallic fitrat aur zameen ki crust mein maujoodgi ki wajah se alkaline earth metals kehte hain. In ki reactivity bohat reactive alkali metals aur kam reactive transition metals ke darmiyan hai.

Maujoodgi: Ca aur Mg zameen ki crust ke aath sab se aam elements mein shamil hain.

Electronic configuration: sab ke bahari s subshell mein do electrons (ns²) hain: Be [He] 2s², Mg [Ne] 3s², Ca [Ar] 4s², Sr [Kr] 5s², Ba [Xe] 6s². Is liye chemical properties milti julti hain, agarche upar se neeche properties badalti hain.

Istemal: Be copper alloys ko aerospace ke liye sakht banata hai; Mg chlorophyll ka aham hissa hai; Mg, Ca, Sr aur Ba apne shokh shoalon ke rangon ki wajah se fireworks ka zaroori hissa hain.

book_ref.quote: These elements present a class of metals having reactivity between

blocks.prompt:
2 Using the data of Table 17.1, describe the trends from Be to Ba in metallic radius, ionic radius, ionization energies, electronegativity and standard electrode potential. How are melting point and density different? (4 marks)
(Table 17.1 ke data se Be se Ba tak metallic radius, ionic radius, ionization energies, electronegativity aur standard electrode potential ke trends bayan karein. Melting point aur density mein kya farq hai?)
blocks.explanation:
Table 17.1 se (Be → Ba):
• Metallic radius barhta hai: 112, 160, 197, 215, 222 pm.
• M²⁺ ka ionic radius barhta hai: 31, 65, 99, 113, 135.
• Pehli ionization energy kam hoti hai: 900, 738, 590, 550, 503; doosri bhi kam hoti hai: 1757, 1451, 1145, 1064, 965.
• Electronegativity kam hoti hai: 1.5, 1.2, 1.0, 1.0, 0.9.
• Standard electrode potential Be se Ba tak zyada negative hota hai (Ca −2.87, Sr −2.89, Ba −2.91 V), yani metals aasaani se electrons khote hain.

Melting point (1287, 650, 842, 777, 727 °C) aur density (1.85, 1.74, 1.54, 2.64, 3.51 g/cm³) ba-qaida nahi badalte. Yeh trends group mein metal atoms ki mukhtalif packing (tarteeb) se mutaliq hain.

blocks.prompt:
3 Explain the chemical reactivity of Group 2 elements on the basis of their electronic configuration. Why does reactivity increase from Be to Ba? Give the reactivity series. (4 marks)
(Group 2 elements ki chemical reactivity ko un ki electronic configuration ki bunyaad par samjhayein. Be se Ba tak reactivity kyun barhti hai? Reactivity series likhein.)
blocks.explanation:
Electronic configuration: Group 2 elements ke bahari subshell mein do electrons (ns²) hain. Yeh do electrons kho kar +2 charge wale stable ions (M²⁺) bante hain, is liye doosre substances se jaldi reaction karte hain.

Be se Ba tak reactivity barhne ki wajoohat:
(i) atomic size barhta hai (Figure 17.1 mein atoms neeche bare hote dikhaye gaye hain);
(ii) andar ke electrons ka shielding effect barhta hai;
(iii) group mein neeche ionization energy kam hoti hai.
Is se do valence electrons nikalna aasaan hota hai aur reactivity barhti hai.

Reactivity series (barhti hui): Be < Mg < Ca < Sr < Ba
Be sab se kam aur Ba sab se zyada reactive hai.

book_ref.quote: The reactivity of Group 2 elements can be explained based on their electronic configuration

blocks.prompt:
4 Describe the reactions of Group 2 metals with oxygen, giving equations. Explain the nature of the oxides formed. (4 marks)
(Group 2 metals ke oxygen ke saath reactions equations ke saath bayan karein. Banne wale oxides ki fitrat samjhayein.)
blocks.explanation:
Aam reaction: tamam Group 2 metals oxygen mein jal kar metal oxides MO banate hain:
2M + O₂ → 2MO

Beryllium sirf zyada temperature (600 °C se upar) par reaction karta hai:
2Be(s) + O₂(g) → 2BeO(s)
Aik patli, mazboot oxide layer usay bachati hai, is liye yeh doosron se kam reactive hai.

Magnesium hawa ya oxygen mein chamak kar jal kar MgO banata hai.
Calcium zyada tezi se reaction kar ke brick red (eent jaisa surkh) shoala deta hai (Figure 17.2).

Oxides ki fitrat: Group 2 oxides aam tor par safaid solids aur basic hain; un ka basic character neeche barhta hai. Paani mein basic character oxide ion aur paani ke reaction se OH⁻ ions banne ki wajah se hai:
O²⁻(s) + H₂O(l) → 2OH⁻(aq)

book_ref.quote: All Group 2 metals burn in oxygen to form metal oxides (MO)

blocks.prompt:
5 Compare the behaviour of beryllium, magnesium and calcium towards cold water and steam, with equations. How does the basic character of the hydroxides change down the group? (4 marks)
(Beryllium, magnesium aur calcium ke thande paani aur steam ke saath rawaiye ka equations ke saath muqabla karein. Hydroxides ka basic character group mein neeche kaise badalta hai?)
blocks.explanation:
Aam: Be ke ilawa Group 2 metals paani se metal hydroxide M(OH)₂ aur hydrogen gas banate hain.

Beryllium: hifazati oxide layer ki wajah se garam karne par bhi paani ya steam se reaction nahi karta.

Magnesium: thande paani se bohat aahista, steam se tez (oxide banta hai):
Mg(s) + 2H₂O(l) → Mg(OH)₂ + H₂(g)   (thanda paani)
Mg(s) + H₂O(g) → MgO(s) + H₂(g)   (steam)

Calcium: thande paani aur steam se Mg se zyada tezi se reaction; Ca(OH)₂ kam hal hota hai aur safaid precipitate banata hai (Figure 17.3):
Ca(s) + 2H₂O(l) → Ca(OH)₂(aq) + H₂(g)

Basic character: Group 2 hydroxides Group 1 se kam basic hain, magar barhti solubility ki wajah se un ka basic character neeche barhta hai.

book_ref.quote: Calcium (Ca) reacts with cold water and steam more vigorously than magnesium

blocks.prompt:
6 Describe the reactions of Group 2 metals with dilute hydrochloric acid and dilute sulphuric acid. Why does the reaction of calcium with sulphuric acid stop early? (4 marks)
(Group 2 metals ke dilute hydrochloric acid aur dilute sulphuric acid ke saath reactions bayan karein. Calcium ka sulphuric acid se reaction jaldi kyun ruk jata hai?)
blocks.explanation:
Aam: Group 2 metals dilute acids se namak (salt) aur hydrogen gas banate hain; reactivity neeche barhti hai.
M(s) + 2HCl(aq) → MCl₂(aq) + H₂(g)

Beryllium: dilute acids se BeCl₂ aur H₂ banata hai, magar hifazati oxide layer reaction aahista kar sakti hai.

Magnesium: dilute acids se aasaani se reaction:
Mg(s) + 2HCl(aq) → MgCl₂(aq) + H₂(g)
Mg(s) + H₂SO₄(aq) → MgSO₄(aq) + H₂(g)

Calcium: dilute acids se tez reaction:
Ca(s) + 2HCl(aq) → CaCl₂(aq) + H₂(g)
Ca(s) + H₂SO₄(aq) → CaSO₄(s) + H₂(g)

Jaldi rukne ki wajah: banne wala calcium sulphate kam hal hota hai; yeh metal ki satah par hifazati teh bana deta hai, acid metal tak nahi pahunchta aur reaction ruk jata hai.

blocks.prompt:
7 Beryllium often behaves differently from the other Group 2 elements. Using the chapter, explain its behaviour towards oxygen, water and dilute acids, and the stability of its carbonate. (4 marks)
(Beryllium aksar doosre Group 2 elements se mukhtalif rawaiya rakhta hai. Chapter ki madad se oxygen, paani aur dilute acids ke saath us ka rawaiya aur us ke carbonate ki stability samjhayein.)
blocks.explanation:
Oxygen: Be sirf 600 °C se upar oxygen se BeO banata hai; patli, mazboot oxide layer usay bachati hai, is liye yeh doosron se kam reactive hai.

Paani: hifazati oxide layer ki wajah se Be garam karne par bhi paani ya steam se reaction nahi karta (baaqi M(OH)₂ aur H₂ dete hain).

Dilute acids: Be BeCl₂ aur H₂ banata hai, magar oxide layer reaction aahista kar sakti hai.

Carbonate: Be²⁺ sab se chhota aur sab se zyada charge density wala Group 2 ion hai, is ki polarizing power sab se zyada hai; yeh CO₃²⁻ ko sab se zyada bigaarta hai aur BeCO₃ sab se kam temperature (250 °C, Table 17.3) par toot jata hai.

Majmooi tor par Be Group 2 ka sab se kam reactive element hai (Be < Mg < Ca < Sr < Ba) kyun ke is ka size sab se chhota aur ionization energy sab se zyada hai.

book_ref.quote: This is due to its protective oxide layer.

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: Be ka chhota size do ulti cheezein karta hai: metal ke taur par yeh electrons mushkil se deta hai (kam reactive), magar ion Be²⁺ ke taur par yeh paas wale anions ko zor se kheenchta hai (zyada polarizing power, is liye BeCO₃ jaldi toot-ta hai).

blocks.prompt:
8 Compare Group 1 (alkali metals) with Group 2 (alkaline earth metals) under at least eight headings. Why are both groups more reactive at the bottom? (4 marks)
(Group 1 (alkali metals) aur Group 2 (alkaline earth metals) ka kam az kam aath unwanaat ke tehat muqabla karein. Dono groups neeche zyada reactive kyun hain?)
blocks.explanation: Group 1 metals ke paas khone ke liye sirf aik electron hai aur woh aasaani se +1 ion banate hain; Group 2 metals do electrons khote hain jis ke liye zyada energy chahiye, is liye woh reactive to hain magar usi period ke Group 1 se kam. Dono groups mein barhte atomic size aur ghatti ionization energy ki wajah se neeche reactivity barhti hai.

book_ref.quote: Table 17.2 Comparison of Group 2 elements with Group 1 elements

rows: Usi period mein kam reactive (zyada ionization energies)
Bohat naram (chaaqu se kat jata hai)
Paani se bohat tez, aksar dhamake daar (Na)
Paani se kam tez (Ca aur paani, Mg aur steam)
Hydroxides kam hal (neeche solubility barhti hai), kam basic

blocks.prompt:
9 What is thermal decomposition? Explain, in terms of the polarizing power of the cation, why the thermal stability of Group 2 carbonates increases down the group. Support your answer with Table 17.3. (4 marks)
(Thermal decomposition kya hai? Cation ki polarizing power ke hawale se samjhayein ke Group 2 carbonates ki thermal stability group mein neeche kyun barhti hai. Table 17.3 se jawab ki tasdeeq karein.)
blocks.explanation:
Thermal decomposition: woh reaction jis mein aik compound garam hone par do ya zyada saada substances mein toot jata hai; bonds todne ke liye energy chahiye (endothermic).

Group 2 carbonates metal oxide aur CO₂ mein toot-te hain:
MgCO₃(s) → MgO(s) + CO₂(g)
CaCO₃(s) → CaO(s) + CO₂(g)

Polarizing power: chhote aur zyada charge wale cations (jaise Be²⁺) ki polarizing power (bigaarne ki taqat) zyada hoti hai. Yeh bare CO₃²⁻ ion ko zyada bigaar kar us ke bonds kamzor kar dete hain, is liye garmi se tootna aasaan hota hai. Group mein neeche M²⁺ bara hota hai, polarizing power kam hoti hai, carbonates zyada stable hote hain aur zyada garmi chahiye (Mg²⁺ aur Ba²⁺ se CO₃²⁻ ki polarisation ka muqabla).

Table 17.3 (1 atm par tootne ka temperature): BeCO₃ 250 °C, MgCO₃ 540 °C, CaCO₃ 900 °C, SrCO₃ 1289 °C, BaCO₃ 1360 °C. BaCO₃ ko sab se zyada temperature chahiye.

book_ref.quote: The above discussed trend is due to the size of the M²⁺ ion

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: Socho CO₃²⁻ aik bara, naram badal (cloud) hai. Chhota Be²⁺ us ke qareeb aa kar electrons ko apni taraf kheench leta hai, C–O bond kamzor ho jata hai aur CO₂ aasaani se alag hota hai. Bara Ba²⁺ itna nahi kheench pata, is liye BaCO₃ ko bohat zyada garmi chahiye.

blocks.prompt:
10 Describe the thermal decomposition of Group 2 nitrates with a balanced equation for strontium nitrate. State and explain the trend in their thermal stability. How is the decomposition pattern useful to chemists? (4 marks)
(Group 2 nitrates ki thermal decomposition bayan karein aur strontium nitrate ki balanced equation likhein. Un ki thermal stability ka trend bayan aur wazeh karein. Decomposition ka pattern chemists ke liye kaise mufeed hai?)
blocks.explanation:
Products: Group 2 nitrates garam hone par metal oxide (MO), bhoori nitrogen dioxide gas (NO₂) aur oxygen gas (O₂) dete hain. Misaal:
2Ca(NO₃)₂(s) → 2CaO(s) + 4NO₂(g) + O₂(g)
2Sr(NO₃)₂(s) → 2SrO(s) + 4NO₂(g) + O₂(g)

Trend: carbonates ki tarah nitrates ki thermal stability bhi Group 2 mein neeche barhti hai. Be(NO₃)₂ sab se kam aur Ba(NO₃)₂ sab se zyada stable hai.

Wajah: upar wale chhote M²⁺ ions ki polarizing power zyada hai; yeh NO₃⁻ ion ko zyada bigaarte hain, is liye kam temperature par tootna aasaan hota hai.

Faida: Group 2 carbonate ya nitrate ke tootne ka temperature dekh kar chemists na-maloom compounds pehchaan aur khaas elements ki tasdeeq kar sakte hain. Yeh pattern ionic size, charge density aur thermal stability ka taalluq bhi dikhata hai.

book_ref.quote: Group 2 nitrates decompose upon heating to form a metal oxide (MO)

blocks.prompt:
11 The solubility of an ionic compound depends on two energy changes. Define enthalpy of hydration, lattice enthalpy and enthalpy of solution, and state the factors that affect the first two. (4 marks)
(Ionic compound ki solubility do energy tabdeeliyon par munhasir hai. Enthalpy of hydration, lattice enthalpy aur enthalpy of solution ki definitions likhein, aur pehli do par asar karne wale awamil batayein.)
blocks.explanation:
Enthalpy of hydration (ΔHhyd): woh energy jo gas wale ions ke paani ke molecules mein ghirne (hydrate hone) par kharij hoti hai. Yeh hamesha exothermic (negative) hai.
Awamil: ions aur paani ki zyada kashish se ΔHhyd zyada negative hoti hai. Chhote, zyada charge density wale ions paani ko zyada kheenchte hain. Group mein neeche ions bare hone se ΔHhyd kam negative hoti hai.

Lattice enthalpy (ΔHlattice): woh energy jo aik mole solid ionic compound ko gas ions mein todne ke liye chahiye. Yeh hamesha endothermic hai.
Awamil: yeh ions ke charge aur size par munhasir hai; lattice mein mazboot forces ka matlab zyada lattice enthalpy. Cation aur anion ke milte julte size par forces mazboot aur lattice energy zyada; aik bara aur doosra bohat chhota ho to forces kamzor aur lattice energy kam.

Enthalpy of solution (ΔHsoln): solid ionic substance ke hal hone par kul energy tabdeeli. Zyada negative ya kam positive ΔHsoln aam tor par zyada solubility ke haq mein hai.

book_ref.quote: depends on the balance between two main energy changes

blocks.prompt:
12 Down Group 2 both the hydration enthalpy of M²⁺ and the lattice enthalpy decrease. Explain how the size of the anion decides which decrease is larger, and use this to account for the opposite solubility trends of the hydroxides and sulphates, quoting data from Table 17.4. (4 marks)
(Group 2 mein neeche M²⁺ ki hydration enthalpy aur lattice enthalpy dono kam hoti hain. Samjhayein ke anion ka size kaise tay karta hai ke kaun si kami zyada hai, aur is se hydroxides aur sulphates ke ulte solubility trends ki wazahat Table 17.4 ke data ke saath karein.)
blocks.explanation:
Group mein neeche M²⁺ bara hota hai, is liye ΔHhyd (M²⁺ ki) aur ΔHlattice dono kam hoti hain. Kaun si kami zyada hai, yeh anion par munhasir hai.

Hydroxides (chhota anion OH⁻): chhote Group 2 metal ions ke saath hydroxides ki lattice energy zyada hoti hai. Neeche jaate hue lattice enthalpy ki kami hydration enthalpy ki kami se zyada hai, is liye hal hona aasaan aur solubility zyada hoti hai.
Data (mol/100 g paani, 298 K): Mg(OH)₂ 2 × 10⁻⁵, Ca(OH)₂ 1.5 × 10⁻³, Sr(OH)₂ 3.4 × 10⁻³, Ba(OH)₂ 1.5 × 10⁻².

Sulphates (bara anion SO₄²⁻): bare sulphate ke liye hydration enthalpy ki kami lattice enthalpy ki kami se zyada hai, is liye solubility neeche kam hoti hai.
Data: MgSO₄ 1.83 × 10⁻¹, CaSO₄ 4.66 × 10⁻³, SrSO₄ 7.11 × 10⁻⁵, BaSO₄ 9.43 × 10⁻⁷ (MgSO₄ hal, BaSO₄ na-hal).

Is tarah dono trends ulte hain (Figure 17.4).

book_ref.quote: But, for a large anion like sulphate, the decrease in hydration enthalpy is more significant than the decrease in lattice enthalpy

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: Yaad rakhne ka tareeqa: hal hone ke liye lattice todni padti hai (energy lagti hai) aur hydration se energy milti hai. Hydroxides mein neeche jaate hue 'lagne wali' energy zyada tezi se kam hoti hai, is liye hal hona aasaan. Sulphates mein 'milne wali' energy zyada tezi se kam hoti hai, is liye hal hona mushkil.

blocks.prompt:
13 Define complex ion and coordination number. Explain the roles of Lewis acid and Lewis base in a complex, and the factors that decide the ability of Group 2 ions to form complexes. (4 marks)
(Complex ion aur coordination number ki definitions likhein. Complex mein Lewis acid aur Lewis base ka kirdaar aur Group 2 ions ki complex banane ki salahiyat ke awamil samjhayein.)
blocks.explanation:
Complex ion: woh ion jis mein markazi metal aas paas ke kai electron dene wale species se bonded ho.

Lewis acid aur base: markazi metal ion Lewis acid (electron pair lene wala) hai; lone pairs wale molecules ya ions, jaise H₂O, NH₃, Cl⁻, OH⁻, Lewis bases hain.

Coordination number: markazi metal ion aur electron donors ke darmiyan coordinate bonds ki tadaad; aam values 2, 4 aur 6.

Group 2 ions: complex banana transition metals mein zyada aam hai (bonding ke liye d-orbitals); Group 2 ions, khaas tor par upar wale, bhi complex banate hain magar rujhan kahin kam hai.
Awamil: (i) size: chhote ions ki charge density (charge aur size ka tanasub) zyada hoti hai aur woh donors ko behtar kheenchte hain; (ii) charge: tamam Group 2 ions par +2 charge hai jo electron pair donors ke liye electrostatic kashish deta hai.

book_ref.quote: The ability of a Group 2 metal ion to form a complex ion depends on its size and charge

blocks.prompt:
14 Describe the hydrated ions formed by Group 2 metal ions in water and the complex of calcium with EDTA. Give the uses of the EDTA complexes. (4 marks)
(Paani mein Group 2 metal ions ke banne wale hydrated ions aur calcium ke EDTA ke saath complex bayan karein. EDTA complexes ke istemal likhein.)
blocks.explanation:
Hydrated ions: Group 2 salts paani mein hal hon to metal ions hydrate ho jate hain; yeh asal mein complex ions hain jin mein paani ke molecules electron pair dete hain.
• Be²⁺: sab se chhota, zyada charge density; paani ko zor se kheench kar [Be(H₂O)₄]²⁺ banata hai, coordination number 4.
• Mg²⁺: bara; aam tor par hexahydrate [Mg(H₂O)₆]²⁺, coordination number 6.
• Ca²⁺, Sr²⁺, Ba²⁺: bhi hydrated ions banate hain, zyada tar coordination number 6, magar neeche taalluq ki taqat kam hoti hai.

EDTA complex: Group 2 ions, khaas tor par chhote, aik se zyada electron pairs dene wale donors ke saath stable complex banate hain; aise donors aik hi ion se kai coordinate bonds bana kar ring jaisi structure banate hain. Ca²⁺ EDTA (chhe electron pairs dene wala) ke saath ring complex banata hai:
Ca²⁺(aq) + EDTA⁴⁻(aq) → [Ca(EDTA)]²⁻(aq)

Istemal: (i) paani naram karna: EDTA sakht paani se Ca²⁺ aur Mg²⁺ nikalta hai; (ii) dawai: EDTA jism se zehreele metal ions (kabhi zaid Ca²⁺) nikalta hai.

book_ref.quote: When Group 2 salts dissolve in water, the metal ions become hydrated

blocks.prompt:
15 Seawater contains only a low concentration of Mg²⁺ ions. Trace how these ions end up as magnesium metal in the Dow process, explaining the purpose of each stage with its equation, and state why the process is regarded as so significant. (4 marks)
(Samandar ke paani mein Mg²⁺ ions ka concentration kam hai. Dow process mein yeh ions magnesium metal tak kaise pahunchte hain, har marhale ka maqsad equation ke saath samjhayein, aur batayein ke yeh process itna aham kyun samjha jata hai.)
blocks.explanation:
Dow process kai qadam wala chemical aur electrochemical process hai jo samandar ke paani ke Mg²⁺ ions se Mg nikalta hai.

Marhala 1, Mg²⁺ ko solid ki shakal mein jama karna: samandar ke paani mein calcium hydroxide (limestone ya seepiyon se) daala jata hai jo magnesium ko na-hal magnesium hydroxide ki shakal mein precipitate karta hai; solid filter kar liya jata hai.
Mg²⁺(aq) + Ca(OH)₂(s) → Mg(OH)₂(s) + Ca²⁺(aq)

Marhala 2, chloride banana: Mg(OH)₂ ko hydrochloric acid se reaction karaya jata hai.
Mg(OH)₂(s) + 2HCl(aq) → MgCl₂(aq) + 2H₂O(l)
MgCl₂ ka mahlool garha aur khushk kiya jata hai.

Marhala 3, electrolysis: pighla MgCl₂ bare electrolytic cells mein electrolyse hota hai; cathode par khalis magnesium aur anode par chlorine gas banti hai.
Mg²⁺(l) + 2Cl⁻(l) → Mg(l) + Cl₂(g)

Ahmiyat: yeh qeemti metal ko wafir magar kam concentration wale zariye (samandar ka paani) se bohat bari sanati miqdaar mein nikalta hai, aur is ne magnesium ki paidawar mein inqilaab la diya.

book_ref.quote: is a multi-step chemical and electrochemical process

blocks.prompt:
16 Describe the production of quicklime from limestone in a lime kiln. Explain why carbon dioxide is removed continuously, and give the uses of quicklime. (4 marks)
(Lime kiln mein limestone se quicklime banane ka tareeqa bayan karein. Carbon dioxide musalsal kyun nikali jati hai, samjhayein, aur quicklime ke istemal likhein.)
blocks.explanation:
Khaam maal: limestone, qudrati tor par wafir sedimentary rock jo zyada tar calcium carbonate hai. Quicklime banana sab se purane aur bunyaadi sanati processes mein se hai.

Tareeqa (calcination, yani thermal decomposition): limestone ko zyada temperature wali bhatti, lime kiln (Figure 17.5), mein aam tor par 900-1000 °C tak garam kiya jata hai. Jadeed kilns mein ajza reaction temperature par gardish karti garam gases se garam hote hain.
CaCO₃(s) → CaO(s) + CO₂(g)   (garmi)

CO₂ nikaalna: band bartan mein reaction reversible hai. CO₂ musalsal nikaalne se equilibrium daayen taraf jata hai aur zyada CaO jaldi banta hai.

Quicklime (calcium oxide) ke istemal: tameerat (cement, mortar, plaster), zaraat (zameen ka ilaaj), metallurgy (steel mein milawat nikalna), flue gas desulphurization aur mukhtalif chemical sanatein.

book_ref.quote: This is one of the oldest and most fundamental industrial processes

blocks.prompt:
17 Describe the uses of Group 2 elements and their compounds in construction and in protecting the environment. Also give the uses of magnesium, strontium and beryllium mentioned in the chapter. (4 marks)
(Tameerat aur mahol ki hifazat mein Group 2 elements aur un ke compounds ke istemal bayan karein. Chapter mein diye gaye magnesium, strontium aur beryllium ke istemal bhi likhein.)
blocks.explanation:
Tameerat:
• Calcium carbonate (limestone, marble, chalk): tameeri maal, cement, concrete aur kaghaz aur plastic mein filler.
• Calcium oxide (quicklime) aur calcium hydroxide (slaked lime): cement, mortar aur plaster; quicklime steel mein milawat bhi nikalta hai.
• Gypsum CaSO₄·2H₂O: plasterboard (drywall) aur plaster of Paris (CaSO₄·½H₂O).

Mahol:
• CaO aur CaCO₃ flue gas desulphurization (wet scrubbing) mein bijli gharon ke dhuen se tezaabi SO₂ nikal kar acid rain rokte hain.
• MgO zyada melting point ki wajah se refractory material (bhatti ki teh) hai.

Metals:
• Magnesium: halke alloys (aerospace, gaariyan), fireworks aur flares (chamak kar jalna).
• Strontium compounds: fireworks aur flares mein surkh rang.
• Beryllium: mazbooti ke liye alloys (springs, aerospace parts) aur X-ray tubes, kyun ke yeh X-rays ke liye shaffaf hai.

book_ref.quote: This is widely used as a building material, in cement, concrete

blocks.prompt:
18 Describe the medical uses of Group 2 compounds. Explain how the low solubility of Mg(OH)₂ and BaSO₄ makes them safe to use. (4 marks)
(Group 2 compounds ke tibbi (medical) istemal bayan karein. Samjhayein ke Mg(OH)₂ aur BaSO₄ ki kam solubility unhein mehfooz kaise banati hai.)
blocks.explanation:
• Magnesium hydroxide Mg(OH)₂ (Milk of Magnesia): maiday ka zaid tezaab neutralize karta hai aur halka julaab hai. Kam solubility isay mehfooz banati hai.
• Calcium carbonate: bad-hazmi ki goliyon mein antacid.
• Calcium compounds (calcium carbonate, calcium citrate): mazboot haddiyon aur daanton ke liye zaroori; osteoporosis se bachao ke liye supplements.
• Magnesium compounds (magnesium sulphate, magnesium citrate): pathon aur aasaab ke kaam ke liye aham; magnesium ki kami ka ilaaj.
• Epsom salts MgSO₄·7H₂O: julaab aur ghusal mein istemal.
• Barium sulphate BaSO₄: nizam-e-hazm ki X-ray tasweer ke liye barium meal. Yeh X-rays ko rokta hai aur bohat na-hal hone ki wajah se jism mein jazb hue baghair guzar jata hai, is liye mehfooz hai (solubility 9.43 × 10⁻⁷ mol/100 g paani, Table 17.4).
• EDTA complexes: jism se zehreele metal ions nikalte hain.

19 Group 2 compounds have diverse uses largely due to their basic nature and varying solubility. Explain this statement with examples from agriculture and other fields. (4 marks)
(Group 2 compounds ke mukhtalif istemal zyada tar un ki basic fitrat aur mukhtalif solubility ki wajah se hain. Is bayan ki wazahat zaraat aur doosre shobon ki misaalon se karein.)
blocks.explanation:
Basic fitrat:
• Zaraat: CaCO₃ aur Ca(OH)₂ tezaabi zameen mein daal kar pH barhaya jata hai (tezaabiyat khatam), is se zameen faslon ke liye behtar hoti hai.
• Mahol: CaO aur CaCO₃ bijli gharon ke dhuen se tezaabi SO₂ nikal kar acid rain rokte hain.
• Dawai: Mg(OH)₂ aur CaCO₃ maiday ka zaid tezaab khatam karte hain (antacids).

Mukhtalif solubility:
• Mg(OH)₂ kam solubility ki wajah se Milk of Magnesia ke taur par mehfooz hai.
• BaSO₄ bohat na-hal hai aur jazb nahi hota, is liye barium meal mein istemal hota hai.
• Hal hone wale compounds jaise calcium nitrate aur magnesium sulphate (Epsom salts) khaad ke taur par istemal ho sakte hain.

Paudon ke ghizaai ajza: calcium aur magnesium zaroori hain; calcium cell wall ki tameer ke liye aur magnesium chlorophyll ka markazi atom hai jo photosynthesis ke liye laazmi hai.
